Consequently its two singular values are equal in every n block, it has exactly a one-dimensional kernel when q!=r, and its singular spectrum is exhaustive. Uniform exponential domination of the scaled coefficients, compact local convergence to ab|a-b|u^3 exp(-(a+b)u), Riemann summation for every p>0, and global supremum control prove the infinite limits. A one-variable maximization yields the claimed sharp rate coefficient. The standalone exact-fraction checker passed 855 supporting finite assertions; this is not used to infer any infinite theorem.
